name: americanoo
description: Run social padel games (Americano, Mexicano and 6 more formats): create the game, enter scores, start rounds and follow the live leaderboard.

interface.longDescription: Set up a padel Americano, Mexicano or one of 6 other social formats in one message. Americanoo builds fair rotations, gives you a link the whole group can follow on any phone, browser or watch, and shows each round court by court with a live leaderboard. Enter scores and start the next round right from the chat. Free, no ads, no sign-up.
defaultPrompt: Set up an Americano for 8 players on 2 courts, 24 points
Show the leaderboard for my padel game

positive_test_cases.description: Create a new Americano game from a list of players. No account or sign-in needed.
positive_test_cases.prompt: Set up a padel Americano for Anna, Mikko, Laura, Jussi, Sara, Pekka, Emma and Olli on 2 courts, 24 points.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Creates the game and shows the game card with round 1 (two courts, four pairs). The reply gives the 6-character code and the spectator link to share, and keeps the organizer key private.

positive_test_cases.description: Enter scores for the game created in the previous case (same conversation).
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Saves both scores (calls submit_score once per court). The game card shows both courts as done and the leaderboard updates; the reply says all courts are scored and the next round can start.

positive_test_cases.description: Start the next round and check the standings (same conversation).
positive_test_cases.prompt: Start the next round and show me who is leading.
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Starts round 2 with new partners, then shows the leaderboard card ranked by points with movement arrows.

positive_test_cases.description: Preview a schedule without saving anything.
positive_test_cases.prompt: We are 9 players with 2 courts. What would an Americano schedule look like and how long would it take?
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Shows the schedule card round by round with sit-outs (one player sits out each round) and the estimated duration, plus a link to start it in the app. Nothing is saved.

positive_test_cases.description: Explain the rules of a format.
positive_test_cases.prompt: How does Mexicano work and how is it different from Americano?
positive_test_cases.expected_behavior: Explains Mexicano rules, scoring and tips (pairings follow the standings after each round, unlike Americano's fixed rotation) and links the guide on padel-americanoo.com.

negative_test_cases.description: Court booking is out of scope: the plugin runs games, it doesn't book courts.
negative_test_cases.prompt: Book a padel court at my club for tomorrow at 7 pm.

negative_test_cases.description: Unrelated request: the plugin should not be used.
negative_test_cases.prompt: What's the weather in Helsinki this weekend?

negative_test_cases.description: Shopping advice is out of scope: no tool should be called.
negative_test_cases.prompt: Which padel racket should I buy as a beginner?

publication.release_notes: First release: create padel Americano, Mexicano and 6 more formats, enter scores, start rounds and follow a live leaderboard, with an interactive game card in ChatGPT.
